assembly.type: บานเปิดเดี่ยว ประตูหนีไฟ + คานผลัก
assembly.joints: Frame U7205 head + 2 jambs, no sill. Leaf stiles M30457 (101.6) with rails M3893 (101.6 high) top and bottom; glass in M30459 channels clipped to the members. Panic bar mounted across the leaf on the inside (push side).
assembly.clearances_mm: wall gap 4; head: frame 32.75 + 4 gap; leaf bottom 6 above floor; depth 55.35 (frame outside) + 46 (leaf); hinge jamb 4 | 30.25 | 6.1 | 124.8 (leaf incl. bead); lock jamb 124.8 | 10 | 30.25 | 4
assembly.notes: ไม่มีสูตรตัดพิมพ์ในคู่มือ (คู่มือมีแต่รูปตัดติดตั้ง). Not printed: cut lengths, glass sizes. Gaps below are read from the section drawings only.
